plans.name: North-South Corridor: River Torrens to Darlington (T2D)
plans.status_now: Under construction; whole project opens to traffic 2031 (tunnel boring for Southern Tunnels H2 2026). 10.5 km, 3 lanes each way.
plans.note: Status and year ok. Fix the URL: confirmed official page is dit.sa.gov.au/nsc/torrens-to-darlington (ours /infrastructure/projects/river-torrens-to-darlington was not found by search; site returns 403 to scripts). Alignment points not checked.

plans.name: South Eastern Freeway upgrades (Glen Osmond to Mount Barker)
plans.status_now: Mount Barker and Verdun interchange upgrades under way (contractors selected June 2025); Crafers-Glen Osmond managed motorway out to tender, early works late 2026, major construction early 2027, $200m.
plans.note: Wording 'in planning (2026)' should say out to tender, construction from 2027. Our URL /south-eastern-freeway-projects was not found by search; use the managed-motorway or adelaide-hills page.

plans.name: Aldinga rail extension (Seaford line)
plans.status_now: Unfunded; to be pursued in the 2030s; no plans in the next decade; 60 m corridor Quinliven Rd to Aldinga Beach Rd preserved.
plans.note: Status and cert concept are honest. Alignment follows the Coast to Vines Trail corridor south of Seaford; not measured.
